macro_cbk.csv — CBK / KNBS macro panel

Columns:
  observe_date   ISO date when the print was observable (YYYY-MM-DD)
  cbk_rate       Central Bank Rate (%)
  tbill_91d      91-day Treasury bill yield (%)
  usd_kes        USD/KES spot
  inflation_yoy  CPI YoY (%)
  lending_rate   Commercial bank lending rate (%)

Current file: curated public anchors (CBR / FX / inflation waypoints from
published CBK/KNBS history), monthly interpolated. Marker file
macro_cbk.csv.official is present so ingest sets macro_source=official.

Replace with a full official extract when available; keep the .official
marker only when the CSV is intentional research/official input.

Rebuild:
  python scripts/build_macro_template.py --approx
  (then recreate macro_cbk.csv.official if desired)
  python scripts/run_ingest.py
